name: nginx-multisite
description: Provisions an Nginx web and reverse-proxy tier with three SSL-enabled sites, static content, virtual-host configuration, and host security hardening including Fail2ban, UFW, sysctl, and SSH controls.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, service enablement, log-directory management, and a post-generation configuration workaround.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a FastAPI application with Python, PostgreSQL, Git, a virtual environment, application dependencies, database and user setup, and a systemd-managed Uvicorn service.
